mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 290 indicates elevated inflation, triggering expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 290, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,500,000 units indicate weakening consumer demand for housing, a key economic component, signaling potential slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (relative to 2017 base) indicates a manufacturing sector contraction, a leading economic slowdown indicator, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1,500,000 units and retail sales below 700 million dollars signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 700, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 thousand signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS < 150000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (relative to 2017 base) indicates a manufacturing sector contraction, a leading economic slowdown indicator, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
